title: 16 November in Bapa’s Diary
subtitle: A special day in BAPS history
headline: Sahajanand Swami becomes leader
story: Sahajanand Swami is appointed the leader of the Sampraday by Ramanand Swami Early morning, before the pre-dawn hours, Ramanand Swami arranged a ritual bath for Sahajanand Swami by the river Bhadarganga.
